## EA Media Tools 2.6.6 - jaguar

### Windows UI toggle fix

- Remove the animated compositor transition from toggle tracks and thumbs. Toggle state still changes immediately, without invalidating the complete frameless window surface.
- Electron's interface remains software-rendered on Windows while FFmpeg hardware decoding and encoding stay available.

### Reliable old-version cleanup

- Unlocked obsolete `app-<version>` directories are still removed during the visible startup splash.
- Locked residual directories are queued for a hidden helper that waits until the application and Squirrel updater have exited, then retries deletion for up to one minute.
- The helper is scheduled during Squirrel's updated event, allowing old `app.asar` remnants to be removed before they accumulate across later releases.
- Only versions older than the running application are eligible. The current version and any newer staged version remain protected.

[Review changes since v2.6.5](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.5...v2.6.6).
